notes: MODEX 2026 will feature 1,000+ exhibitors across warehouse automation, material handling, robotics, supply chain software, and logistics technology. The event takes place April 13-16, 2026 at Georgia World Congress Center in Atlanta. While the complete official exhibitor directory exists at mx2026.mapyourshow.com, individual company names require interactive browsing. This list includes 15 confirmed exhibitors (verified through official sources, press releases, and booth assignments) and 27 highly likely exhibitors based on industry leadership, past participation, and relevance to MODEX's core themes: AI + machine learning, robotics, AMRs/AGVs, warehouse automation, AS/RS, conveyor systems, WMS/TMS software, and supply chain visibility. Key ICP-fit companies include The Home Depot (keynote, owns SRS Distribution which is an InstaLILY customer), Barnes & Noble (distribution operations), and numerous material handling equipment manufacturers and distributors. Attendee profile: 86% are decision makers, 60,000+ expected attendees, $70B+ collective purchasing power, 80% of top 100 retailers represented.
